C0771.title: Release of GB/T 39786-2021 Basic Requirements for Commercial Cryptography Application
C0771.summary: In March 2021, the national standard GB/T 39786-2021 Information Security Technology - Baseline Requirements for Cryptographic Application of Information Systems was officially released and scheduled to take effect on October 1, 2021. The State Cryptography Administration stated that the standard guides commercial cryptography application and security assessment, helping information systems apply cryptography in a compliant, correct, and effective manner. It also provides baseline reference for commercial cryptography deployment in IoT and industry systems, including key management, cryptographic services, and assessment boundaries.
